R254.note: Service-level @PreAuthorize delegating to an ownership bean is the right Spring shape and method security is already enabled by the controller; only side effect is a not-found order now yields 403 instead of the NoSuchElementException, which affects no legitimate caller.

R255.note: GraalVM Context.create("js") defaults to HostAccess.NONE with no host class lookup, IO or threads, so the script can no longer reach Java; but result.asBoolean() throws an unchecked ClassCastException for any rule that evaluates to a non-boolean where the original returned false via Boolean.TRUE.equals, and Nashorn-specific rule syntax may stop parsing - neither is stated.

R256.note: execFileSync with an argument array removes the shell; sourcePath and thumbPath are prefixed by fixed directories and geometry is consumed as the -resize operand, so no shell or option injection remains and behaviour is otherwise unchanged.

R257.note: Switches findAll() to the existing findByOwnerUsername(authentication.getName()), matching the detail endpoint and the stated contract exactly.

R258.note: Moving the username into a slog.String attribute is correct - the default, Text and JSON handlers quote or escape control characters in attribute values while the message stays constant; the log line format change is inherent to the fix and stated.

R259.note: Per-stream ObjectInputFilter allowlisting RestoredSession and String with !* closes gadget instantiation while preserving the wire format and the IllegalArgumentException path; the [L*; entry is an inert exact-match pattern (no trailing *), harmless here since the record needs no arrays.

R260.note: Parameterised SqlCommand passed to SqlDataAdapter(cmd) closes the injection; Fill opens and closes the connection itself, and the Customers DataTable and column set are unchanged.

R261.note: Service-level ownership check before deleteById closes the vector, but the contract asks that non-owned IDs reveal no more than the existing not-found path and the fix returns 403 for an existing document owned by someone else, disclosing its existence; getOwner().equals also NPEs on a null owner.

R262.note: Tika byte detection with a neutral .tmp suffix is the right replacement for probeContentType, but the stated extras change the stored artefact: images are re-encoded through ImageIO (lossy JPEG recompression, EXIF stripped, CMYK/unsupported-but-valid JPEGs rejected with 415) and the returned stored name now carries an extension.

R263.note: Positional $1/$2 bind parameters via Sequelize's bind option are the correct parameterisation for sequelize.query and the query semantics are otherwise unchanged.

R264.note: Hand-built RESP multibulk framing with byte-length prefixes is the correct fix for a raw-socket Redis client; lengths are computed on the UTF-8 encoding that is finally sent, so CRLF or spaces in locale or session_id cannot split the command, and the reply handling is unchanged.

R265.note: Adds the missing length <= receivedByteCount - 2 check before memmove, with the subtraction guarded by the existing >= 2 check; return values and valid-message behaviour unchanged.

R266.note: Dropping cmd.exe /c for a direct ProcessBuilder argument list closes the shell injection, but the added [a-zA-Z0-9.-]+ host allowlist rejects IPv6 targets a support operator could legitimately ping, and the new IllegalArgumentExceptions surface as 500s; the restriction is stated but not called for by the case.

R267.note: Changing Body to string and dropping the template.HTML cast restores html/template contextual escaping; the only output change is the escaping that constitutes the fix.

R268.note: isabs rejection plus normpath containment against BASE_DIR + os.sep closes both the absolute-path join discard and .. traversal while leaving every real file under BASE_DIR (including subdirectories) reachable.
